description: This file defines the Permission class within the Opencart admin startup controllers namespace. It contains logic to check user permissions for accessing certain routes, and excludes some routes from permission checks.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Controller class responsible for permission checks during startup, particularly for access control based on user permissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks if the current route is authorized for the user, ignoring some predefined routes. Returns an Action object redirecting to an error page if permission is denied, otherwise null.
